profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Engineering & Infrastructure Leadership

I am an engineering leader specializing in the architecture, deployment, and scaling of high-performance infrastructure and networking systems. My experience spans major sectors: cloud computing, aerospace, social platforms, and industrial automation.

I currently lead the Google Cloud Bare Metal team, responsible for successfully bringing new bare metal shapes into production. This requires orchestrating collaboration across networking, platform, storage, maintenance, and production engineering teams to deliver robust solutions.

Previously, I spearheaded the Software Defined Networking effort for Amazon Project Kuiper, delivering a comprehensive, Rust-based SDN stack for embedded vehicle and cloud ground systems. During my time at Meta, I served as a Tech Lead Manager, building and growing a key Seattle-based team focused on Instagram and WhatsApp traffic shaping and multi-user video messaging features. I also led an ML Infrastructure team at Meta, focusing on enabling ML trainers. A key achievement included contributions to the creation of the Training Super Cluster (TSC), specifically optimizing data paths and flow into and out of the cluster to reduce overall traffic and minimize latency.

Technical and Management Profile

A hands-on engineering manager skilled in C++, Rust, and Python. I excel at leading hybrid SWE and SRE teams with a deep commitment to reliability and engineering excellence. My approach involves close partnership with PMs, TPMs, and senior leadership to ensure technical execution directly supports strategic business objectives.

I am also a recognized domain expert in ultra-low latency distributed systems, previously advising exchanges and proprietary trading firms. My background includes leading the professional services vertical for Informatica Ultra Messaging as a global customer-facing architect. Earlier in my career, I spent ten years in industrial robotics at Panasonic Factory Automation, delivering integrated solutions for global manufacturers including Ford, Nokia, and Xerox.

positions.description:

Architects and defines internal and external APIs enabling precise interface and
control of individual robots and multi-unit fleet management at scale.

positions.title: Engineering Manager AI & Computing Infrastructure
positions.description:
Delivered specialized bare-metal infrastructure engineered for deterministic performance, enabling ultra-low-latency trading workflows to run with the same precision that would be expect from traditional on-premises colocation facilities.

Collaborated closely with Google customer on platform design and workload validation, helping shape the industry-first trading platform by combining bare-metal systems, HPC capabilities, and cloud automation to modernize capital-markets infrastructure without compromising speed or reliability.

positions.title: Engineering Manager SDN and Network Architecture @Project Kuiper at Amazon
positions.description:
• Directed teams building a distributed network management plane across
cloud (SDN)(L3-L7), embedded, and terrestrial environments.
• Led R&D eﬀorts to define new architectures and design patterns for
Kuiper’s satellite program.
• Guided organizational restructuring and resource alignment to meet
business goals.
• Defined multi-year technical vision and hiring strategy for SDN
development and innovation.
• Managed and mentored software developers, data scientists, and applied
scientists.
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · Continuous Integration (CI) · Networking · C++ · Continuous Monitoring · Team Leadership · People Management

positions.title: Principal Engineer, AI Infra
positions.description:
• Improved efficiency and reliability across Meta’s AI/ML infrastructure
platforms.
• Formed team to modularize system dependencies, improving deployment
quality and velocity. (SWE & SRE team)
• Partnered with data warehouse teams to create a unified reporting
language across systems.
• Optimized data placement to reduce inter-data-center traffic and improve
ML performance.
• Streamlined SEV event handling and reduced mean time to mitigate
incidents.
• Introduced stable system contracts and microservice transformations for
reliability and maintainability.

positions.title: Principal Engineer - AI Infra/Realtime communication
positions.description:
• Helped found a RTC relay team, growing from 0 to 5 engineers in one year.
(SWE & SRE team)
• Separated CDN and RTC traffic, improving real-time performance and
reliability.
• Re-architected the relay system to be stateless, improving quality and
maintainability.
• Unified backend services across Instagram and WhatsApp to reduce
system footprint.
• Automated real-time traffic routing across L4/L7 load balancers and BGP
edges, dynamically steering user traffic for optimal latency and availability.
